programs.title: The Equalizer 3
programs.desc: It's a Robert McCall recall as Denzel Washington tackles the mob in Italy for the 'final chapter' of the ultra-violent vigilante action franchise. Fatti sotto! Antoine Fuqua directs.

programs.title: Fever Pitch
programs.desc: It's 1989 and Paul adores Arsenal. It's been about 20 years since they last won the league. Sounds familiar? Well this year, they're getting close - and Paul's getting nervous.

programs.title: Jamie's One-Pan Wonders
programs.desc: Jamie Oliver shows us how to make a super-fast, flavoursome smoky noodle soup, the cleverest home-made bread, and a chicken and mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.
